tasks.subject: Task 4: Upstream Hyperliquid WS client (hl-stream.js)
tasks.description:

```json:metadata
{"files": ["hl-stream.js", "test/hl-stream.test.js"], "verifyCommand": "node --test test/hl-stream.test.js", "acceptanceCriteria": ["watch/unwatch ref-count webData2", "track adds persistent userFills", "on (re)open resends all subs", "webData2->account event, userFills->fills event"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 5: Browser WS hub (ws-server.js) + wire into server.js
tasks.description:
**Goal:** /ws hub: watch handling drives stream.track/watch, persists fills+snapshots from stream events, broadcasts account/realized/snapshot.

**Files:** ws-server.js, server.js (modify startup)

**Verify:** npm start; browser devtools shows /ws connect + account/snapshot frames after watching

```json:metadata
{"files": ["ws-server.js", "server.js"], "verifyCommand": "npm start (manual browser verify)", "acceptanceCriteria": ["client watch -> stream.track+watch", "stream.account -> broadcast + throttled snapshot", "stream.fills -> ingest + broadcast realized", "disconnect -> unwatch"]}
```
